narr: Post Tropical Storm Elsa moved along the Downeast coast during the afternoon and evening of the 9th bringing abundant tropical moisture and heavy rains to Downeast areas. Rainfall rates occasionally reached 1.00 to 2.00 inches per hour. Rainfall totals across Downeast areas through the afternoon and evening generally ranged from 2.50 to 4.00 inches...though local totals exceeded 5.00 inches. The heavy rains produced localized flash flooding in the Bangor and Brewer areas. Several roads were closed due to street flooding. Low antecedent river and stream levels helped mitigate the flood threat.
ev: Heavy rains caused several road closures due to high water in the Bangor and Brewer areas. Canterbury and Church Roads were flooded in Brewer. An exit on Interstate 395 was closed due to a dirt washout across the road. In Bangor...Perry Road was closed at the Route 202 overpass due to street flooding.
